card.name: Dosing frequency: times per day or week
card.fires_on: The word 'times' after a number (three times, 4 times) in dose schedules, and similar spots such as 'hours' after 'every 6' or 'spaced' in 'equally spaced doses'. A weaker case is 'boxes' or 'of' in pack-size wording.

modes.label: Times per period
modes.description: 'times' after a count in daily or weekly dosing frequency.
modes.example: administer three<< times>> per week and at least 48

modes.label: Interval wording
modes.description: Hours after 'every N', or 'spaced' in evenly divided doses.

modes.label: Pack size wording
modes.description: Words in box and vial count descriptions.
modes.example: 0661 (30 vials) Available in<< boxes>> consisting of 30 reaction vials

card.writes: It promotes words about even spacing and symmetry, such as 'evenly' and 'spaced', so the text goes on to describe regular intervals.
card.plain: It marks the spot in a dosing schedule where the text says how often or how evenly spaced the doses are.
